Compute Match — Analytics with Superset
Apache Superset ( superset/ ) provides dashboards for Platform Admins. Locally, start it with make 
onboard ONBOARD_ARGS="--with-analytics"  and open http://localhost:8088  with the operations demo
account.
Access
Custom role DashboardViewer: can view dashboards, charts and datasets in the analytics
schema only; no SQL Lab, no query editing, no database admin.
Keycloak role superset_dashboard_viewers  (part of the Platform Admin composite) maps to
DashboardViewer ( superset/superset_config.py , superset/custom_roles.py ).
In the app, Platform Admins open it via the external Dashboard menu item.
Dashboard 1 — Compute MatchMake System Metrics
(marketplace)
Deﬁned in superset/dashboards/marketplace_metrics.py .
Request analytics: total requests, requests per week, average time to contract (overall and
by NCP), conversion rate (overall and by GPU), acceptance and rejection by NCP, custom-
request percentage, contracted GPUs by month and platform.
User analytics: NCP and customer activity tiers with detail tables, new sign-ups in the last 4
weeks, logins per user over 90 days.
Capacity analytics: available, reserved and future GPUs, NCPs with capacity, capacity by
platform and region, future pipeline by month.
Sources: views such as analytics.v_reservation_request_* , v_ncp_activity , v_customer_activity ,
v_user_actions , v_ncp_capacity_overview , v_future_pipeline_by_month .
Dashboard 2 — Feedback
Deﬁned in superset/dashboards/feedback_metrics.py . KPIs: average rating, number of responses,
satisﬁed versus dissatisﬁed, rating distribution, top reasons, journey summary, recent feedback.
Filters: time, persona, journey. Source: analytics.v_feedback  and a funnel view.
